security_admin.description: Full security administration: IPS management, NAC admission, policy updates, vault secrets, backup/restore, AI auditing.

network_admin.description: Manages VPN tunnels, VLANs, firewall ACLs, NAC registry, and network availability diagnostics.

system_admin.description: Manages Vault server availability, encrypted backups, disaster recovery, and system configuration.

security_analyst.description: SOC analyst with read access to SIEM logs, IPS alerts, vulnerability scans, AI threat auditing, and security reports.

it_manager.description: Executive oversight: views compliance reports, risk assessments, SIEM summaries, and AI audit briefings.

end_user.description: Standard authenticated employee with least-privilege encrypted tunnel access and vault read access only.
